metadata.description: Productivity plugins for Claude Code to automate development workflows

plugins.name: speckit
plugins.description: GitHub SpecKit integration for Specification-Driven Development - define WHAT and HOW before coding

plugins.name: smart-git-commit
plugins.description: Automatically generate Gitmoji-based Korean commit messages by analyzing project changes, then execute commits and pushes after user approval.

plugins.name: web-ui-design-guide
plugins.description: Ensure every web UI component built looks modern and professional by applying systematic design principles. This skill provides comprehensive guidelines for color, spacing, typography, and component-specific patterns to achieve clean, minimal, and consistent user interfaces.

plugins.name: ios-ui-design-guide
plugins.description: Build native iOS interfaces that look professional and follow Apple Human Interface Guidelines (HIG) by applying systematic design principles. This skill provides comprehensive guidelines for SwiftUI-first development with color system, spacing, typography, and component-specific patterns optimized for iOS.

plugins.name: android-ui-design-guide
plugins.description: Build native Android interfaces that follow Material Design 3 (Material You) by applying systematic design principles. This skill provides comprehensive guidelines for Jetpack Compose-first development with Dynamic Color, spacing, typography, and component-specific patterns optimized for Android.

plugins.name: flutter-ui-design-guide
plugins.description: Build cross-platform Flutter apps with Material Design (Android) and Cupertino (iOS) support. This skill provides guidelines for adaptive widgets, theming, spacing, typography, and component patterns optimized for both platforms.

plugins.name: smart-linear-issue
plugins.description: Linear 이슈 생성/수정/코멘트 기능을 제공하는 스킬. Gitmoji 기반 한글 제목과 사용자 승인 워크플로우로 일관된 이슈 관리를 지원합니다.
